cross_critic.flag: RM is not sound for DoorKey. 1) Impossible/harmful rejection transitions: u0->u2 is taken when door_open&!has_key, but door_open cannot become true before has_key (toggle without key does nothing), so that label is unreachable, and the related -4 penalty invites spurious credit shaping. Similarly u0->u2 on at_goal&door_open&has_key (u4, +1.3) is fine, but u0 also lacks a self-loop covering the overwhelmingly frequent event (no has_key, no door_open, not at goal): with no matching transition and no else/self-loop, the machine has no defined transition for (u0, !at_goal&!door_open&!has_key) — the very first state of every episode. Uncovered event labels must fall to an explicit self-loop (per-state else), else the RM is partial and undefined at episode start. 2) u1 likewise misses the event !at_goal&!door_open (agent carrying key, door still shut, still navigating) — its most common label — again undefined; only u2 rejection... which shouldn't exist. 3) REJECTING_STATES u2 conflates no meaningful failure: nothing in DoorKey is a hard failure; dropping the key while the door is closed (key_lost) is a recoverable setback, not failure. Rejecting on at_goal&!door_open is actually unreachable (goal requires the door open). 4) key_lost is never handled: the event can fire (94/300 episodes) and the RM has no transitions or regressions keyed to it, ignoring the drop/pickup dynamics entirely. 5) Rewards are not dense and are mis-scaled: a positive reward at u0 for has_key is acceptable, but total shaping (0.1+0.1) plus terminal bonuses (1.1–1.3) exceeds the environment's success magnitude (≤1) — reward safety violated; HARD_FAILED_REWARD -4 per step is unbounded over long horizons. 6) u2 listed in REJECTING_STATES but FINAL_STATES only names u4 while ACCEPTING_STATES is empty — accept set must be declared. 7) PENDING_PROMISES are listed but no promise/target transitions are shown to justify the counts, and no transition to u2 from u3 exists even though the agent could in principle... (at least the at_goal event is covered from u3). Fix: add per-state else self-loops, remove the -4 rejection path, cover key_lost explicitly, keep cumulative reward ≤1, and declare accepting states properly.

cross_critic.flag: Multiple structural and semantic defects. (1) Order violations: transitions (u0, at_goal&!door_open&!has_key)->u2 and (u0, at_goal&door_open)->u2 accept reaching the goal without ever acquiring the key or opening the door, contradicting the task 'open the door after acquiring the key'. Constraint at_goal cannot hold before door_open also makes (u0, at_goal&...) unreachable, but the reach-goal-without-key branch is unambiguously wrong. (2) FINAL_STATES header lists only u2, but u3 is accepting-relevant (it is a required pass-through state); with no declared accepting semantics for u3 the machine's language/acceptance is ill-defined for traces passing through u3. (3) Regression handling: (u1, !at_goal&door_open)->u0 returns to u0, but has_key still holds after opening the door (key is kept), so the agent in u0 with has_key would transition again to u1 with reward -0.1 — spurious penalty and potential loop; the regression on door_open (door toggled shut) should keep the agent in u1 with an explicit negative/no reward, not reset to u0. (4) Dense bounded progress: rewards are dense but negative (-0.1) for required progress to u1; progress should be nonnegative and bounded, and the final reward 1.1/1.2 exceeds the environment's 1 minus 0.9-fraction bound range semantics (max 1), unbounded/inconsistent with the success reward convention. (5) Ordered transition coverage: key_lost events are not covered anywhere; the machine must handle key_lost self-loops (with an explicit regression penalty, since key_lost represents losing the key before the door opens) — no transition on !has_key from u0 or u1 exists, so key_lost steps fall to unspecified else behavior; per-state else self-loops must be explicit. (6) Irrelevant events (turns, moves, no-op done, has_key/door_open unchanged) are not covered by else self-loops in any state. (7) Event/persistence distinction: key_lost is an event (one step); the RM must not treat it as persistent, but it also must not ignore it. Overall: reject; redesign with strict order u0(key)→u1(door)→u2(goal), explicit key_lost self-loops with negative reward, door-shut regression staying in u1, else self-loops everywhere, nonnegative dense bounded progress, and final reward within [0,1].

PENDING_PROMISES:

cross_critic.flag: Multiple problems. (1) Missing key_lost handling: key_lost is a declared event predicate (fires when the key is dropped before the door opens), but no transition or reward in the RM references it, and per-state else self-loops do not disambiguate it. From u0, a labeling with key_lost=true, door_open=false, has_door_key=false, target_picked_up=false (the natural situation after a pre-unlock drop) matches no listed u0 transition, so the machine is not total over reachable labelings; the else self-loop requirement for irrelevant/unlisted events is violated. From u2 (agent had key, then lost it), staying or regressing must be explicit: a key_lost labeling in u2 matches no transition (e.g. !door_open&!has_door_key&!target_picked_up with key_lost true is uncovered), and the drop-then-reacquire path back to key possession in u2 is unmodelled (u2 assumes has_door_key, but u2's incoming edge requires has_door_key yet the state persists after the key is dropped). (2) Reachability/coverage: (u3, !door_open ...) has no transition at all — door_open can toggle false again after u3 (relock is impossible but toggle-shut is allowed per environment), yet u3's only outgoing edge requires target_picked_up; a labeling with door_open=false and target_picked_up=false in u3 matches nothing, breaking totality. (3) Transition consistency: (u0, door_open&!has_door_key&target_picked_up) -> u1 is impossible given the constraint that target_picked_up requires door_open but here door_open alone with no key cannot precede... actually door_open&!has_door_key&target_picked_up is reachable only if the agent dropped the key, opened the door, then... cannot have picked the box while holding the key, so this is reachable only via drop-then-pickup which is fine — but sending it to rejecting u1 is wrong: the agent may have legitimately opened the door and merely dropped the key; that is not a failure of the task 'acquire key, unlock, pick up box'. Rejecting u1 on this edge mislabels legal progress as hard failure. (4) Rewards: (u0, door_open&has_door_key&target_picked_up, u4) -> 1.3 exceeds the 1.0 final reward convention and is inconsistent with other u4 entries (1.1, 1.2); terminal rewards should be uniform. Reward 1.3 also breaks boundedness consistency with the FINAL reward structure. (5) PENDING_PROMISES counts (3/2/1) do not match remaining hard steps: u0->u2 leaves 2, u2->u3 leaves 1, u3->u4 leaves 0 — this is consistent, but u0->u3 direct (door_open&has_door_key&!target_picked_up) skips u2 and leaves promise accounting ambiguous. (6) Regression: dropping the key in u2 (key_lost) should be an explicit regression transition back to u0 or an explicit self-loop with penalty; it is absent. Fix totality over key_lost and door_open-toggling-off labelings, correct the u1 rejection edges, and normalize terminal rewards.
